structuredContent.body:
An authored mutation error currently appears as a resumable internal fault. This change publishes nonresumable `MUTATION_ERROR` failures with the node, operation index/kind and a bounded author diagnostic. Authored Exit evaluation errors use `EXPRESSION_ERROR`. Unexpected failures keep their recovery behavior while newly published run records and events exclude private exception messages, paths and stacks; correlated server logs retain the diagnostic.

The handling preserves atomic mutations, repair and raw-fallback outcomes, cancellation/deadline precedence, script classification, inference recording order, and subloop recovery metadata. Historical rows and events are unchanged. ADR-0080, the numbered documentation, CHANGELOG and generated API types describe the new-record boundary.

Closes #381. Incorporates the criteria consolidated from #414.

Validation:

- Focused candidate checks: 1,070 tests; final isolated domain coverage: 460 tests, 98.74% lines / 95.98% branches; final engine coverage: 1,812 tests, 96.94% lines / 91.22% branches. Types, lint, schema generation, templates, licences, documentation and contrast checks are recorded in the [implementation evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/5082bc176e92cf3518abb630a5afc0a59c444815/docs/qa/2026-11-15-runtime-failure-implementation/README.md).
- Independent candidate QA: 18 functional and 13 internal cases on the frozen source/build, with explicit zero-exit receipts and owned-resource cleanup. This includes compiled REST/stdio MCP, real SQLite, the served Edge inspector, controlled fault ports and two native Node script controls. [Candidate evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/5082bc176e92cf3518abb630a5afc0a59c444815/docs/qa/2026-11-15-runtime-failure-candidate/README.md)
- The original full local `pnpm check` failed during coverage. The packet preserves its complete outputs, later isolated results and unresolved causes in unrelated Windows suites; it does not claim a green full local run. Current publication-head CI remains a separate required gate.
- The [unchanged-main baseline](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/5082bc176e92cf3518abb630a5afc0a59c444815/docs/qa/2026-11-15-runtime-failure-baseline/README.md) preserves the reproduced behavior and original fixture/supervisor failures, including the missing internal baseline harness exit value.

Current publication head: `693ea3c9d05359f6ebee8822dd566c99c3e4973c`, tree `7e611f71ac8b3693d574b8f08869d68fed19af4b`, against main `f91bd69b79dc417a2997ddb9c7670cb33df7597c`. [CI run 43745479496](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43745479496) is now successful on this exact revision. Attempt 1 passed Browser (481 tests and one expected live-provider skip), Windows launcher (14 tests) and Template image. Its Gates job was cancelled at the configured 30-minute job limit after ten coverage groups, with later checks skipped. The original failure and partial artifact are retained. Exactly one unchanged-head [Gates-only retry](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43745479496/job/132918799467) passed all 32 steps and all 13 coverage groups: 9,605 tests passed / 41 skipped, with every package above 90% lines and branches. Licences, generated docs, contrast and the configured dependency audit passed. The successful Browser/Windows/Template outcomes are carried forward from their original executions; they did not rerun. No assertions, thresholds, time limits or workflow inputs changed. The exact tested synthetic merge is `955dccf755f5f34387f990ff47fa49c7bbf45f55`, with target/head parents and the same publication tree. The earlier failed 5082 run and green 656a run are retained with their exact identities and limitations in the [CI packet](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/693ea3c9d05359f6ebee8822dd566c99c3e4973c/docs/qa/2026-11-15-runtime-failure-ci/README.md); neither substitutes for this head's gates.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh completed formal scan 1 with CHANGES REQUIRED for documentation only; it found no product or test blocker. GPT-6 Luna xhigh corrected the three affected documents, and separate GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh factual QA passed. F1 now accurately describes safe public diagnostics, correlated private logs and the named remaining authored evaluation boundaries; FU2 adds the current MUTATION_ERROR recovery instruction. Product, test and build inputs remain unchanged from source `615d50bc358d73bc55ad0591f4f625f1a46cb671`. Scoped formatting and diff checks passed. [Full review and dispositions](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/485#issuecomment-6898705327) · [Review and correction evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/693ea3c9d05359f6ebee8822dd566c99c3e4973c/docs/qa/2026-11-15-runtime-failure-review/README.md)

Broader authored-error classification is parked in #486 outside this batch. Fresh independent GPT-6 Astra max scan 2 returned [SIGN-OFF](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/485#issuecomment-6900116835) for this exact head, target and tree. It independently closed F1 and FU2, checked all 32 bound inputs, seven published evidence inventories, 1,231 build outputs, candidate durable outcomes and complete current CI, and found no new actionable blocker. Root read the full report and verified its 19-file audit inventory. The shared three-scan budget used 2 scans. Engineering gates are complete; merge and issue closure are recorded separately, and this is not owner acceptance.

The evidence-only publication also records the already merged PR #484's [CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/5082bc176e92cf3518abb630a5afc0a59c444815/docs/qa/2026-11-15-poll-dedupe-current-ci/README.md) and [completion](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/5082bc176e92cf3518abb630a5afc0a59c444815/docs/qa/2026-11-15-poll-dedupe-completion/README.md). The delivery register keeps subsequent #410, #419 and launcher work separate.
